card.name: Newsletter and update frequency phrasing
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation inside sentences about receiving updates, email lists or how often something happens, such as "we'll just keep you posted" or "weekly e-mail with".

modes.label: Mailing list sign-up
modes.description: Words in newsletter or email sign-up pitches, especially around how often updates arrive.
modes.example: You won't be inundated with emails! —<< we>>'ll just keep you posted periodically — about

modes.label: Habitual or regular action
modes.description: Words in a first-person or system description of routine, repeated actions.
modes.example: I<< regularly>> find myself correcting English natives's writing.

card.plain: It lights up on small words in email sign-up blurbs and talk of regular updates.
